task_description: Make product action buttons always visible on touch devices by removing hover-only opacity pattern

patterns.current_pattern: opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 - buttons invisible until hover
patterns.new_pattern: Always visible buttons with subtle opacity (opacity-70 group-hover:opacity-100) or touch-specific media queries
patterns.tailwind_classes: Use Tailwind utility classes, no custom CSS needed
patterns.accessibility: Buttons must be discoverable on touch devices (tablets, phones)

existing_implementations.description: Found 4 occurrences of opacity-0 group-hover pattern in dashboard pages

problem_analysis.issue: Action buttons (edit, delete) are hidden with opacity-0 until mouse hover
problem_analysis.impact: Touch device users (tablets, phones) cannot access these critical actions
problem_analysis.affected_users: Restaurant staff using tablets for management
problem_analysis.severity: High - breaks core functionality on touch devices
